# papyrium-model-star-lc10

The Star LC-10 Multi-Font, a 9-pin dot-matrix printer of 1987, for
Papyrium, in its Standard mode, in which it follows the Epson LX-800,
speaking ESC/P through `papyrium-language-escp`. `docs/star-lc-10.md`
records the behaviour from Star's manuals, and `docs/star-lc10-firmware.md`
what the LC-10 Colour's firmware shows.

It prints with the LC-10's own characters, from `papyrium-font-lc10`, and
forms them as its firmware does: draft, with pica made from the Sanserif
typeface at half width and elite from the ROM's draft table; and four
near letter quality typefaces, Courier, Sanserif, and Orator with small
capitals or with lower case, each in pica and elite, printed in two
passes half a dot apart, at fixed pitch or proportionally spaced. Italic
slants every character, draft and NLQ, as the firmware does, each
column's dots moving further right the higher they are. The IBM block graphics are twelve dots high, as the
printer prints them, so that boxes join at 1/6 inch line spacing.

## Demonstration page

<img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rob-smallshire/papyrium/master/docs/images/demo-star-lc10.png" alt="The star-lc10 demonstration page" width="100%">

Print it yourself, as PNG and PDF, with `papyrium demo star-lc10`; `-M`
options set the printer up, such as `-M stationery=green-bar`.

Registered as `star-lc10` on the `papyrium.model` axis. The options model
the printer's DIP switches and paper:

| Option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `form-length` | `11` | Form length in inches (switch 1-1 gives 11 or 12) |
| `graphics-table` | `no` | Codes 128-254 from IBM character set #2 rather than italics (switch 1-7 off) |
| `auto-line-feed` | `no` | Each carriage return also feeds a line (switch 1-8 off) |
| `character-set` | `usa` | Power-on international set: any of the thirteen `ESC R` sets, by name or number (switches 2-2 to 2-4 give 0-7) |
| `paper-width` | `9.5`, or `8.5` for `sheet` | Paper width in inches, tear-off strips included; the line is centred on it |
| `top-offset` | `19/36` | Inches from the perforation to the top of the first line |
| `stationery` | `fanfold` | The paper: `fanfold` (plain, with tear-off strips), `sheet` (no strips), `green-bar`, `blue-bar`, `music-ruled` |
| `font` | `lc10-draft` | The pica draft characters: an installed font's name, or the path of a dot font file |
| `elite-font` | `lc10-draft-elite` | The elite draft characters: an installed font's name, or the path of a dot font file |

Star's additions to ESC/P are obeyed: absolute and relative positioning
(`ESC $`, `ESC \`), both margins at once (`ESC X`), extra space between
characters (`ESC SP`), moving to a column (`ESC f 0`), the slashed zero (`ESC ~`), overline (`ESC _`),
the top margin (`ESC c`), reverse line feed and top of page (`ESC LF`, `ESC FF`) and the macro (`ESC +`). Character
sizes print as the LC-10 prints them, always in near letter quality:
double and quadruple size and their halves (`ESC h`), double height on
the base line (`ESC w`), and `ESC [ @`.

Not modelled yet: IBM mode (switch 1-6), proportional spacing in elite, LF without a carriage return (switch
1-2), download characters as the LC-10 defines them, and the LC-10
Colour.
